mechanism: Darunavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase levodopa levels and CNS dopaminergic effects; potential for enhanced adverse effects including dyskinesias, psychosis, and cardiovascular complications.
action: Monitor for increased levodopa toxicity signs (dyskinesias, hallucinations, orthostatic hypotension); consider levodopa dose reduction if adverse effects emerge; ensure regular blood pressure and cardiac monitoring.
